Intuition
With constant weights, adjacent potentials cancel completely; changing weights leaves their successive differences.
Why it is needed
Expose the source algebra without weakening it to a diameter inequality or dropping the terminal residual.
Place in the proof
Orabona v10, printed14/PDF26, Theorem2.13 proof second display equality. Locally compiled and independently source/BODY-reviewed exact identity with explicit algebraic generalization. Combined package gates remain pending. Chapter2 remains partial, accepted=false and complete proof denominator=null; all eight forward containers and six future claims remain open. Whole Chapters1-16 Goal ACTIVE; unmerged and unpublished.
Proof and Lean reading notes
Proof idea
Write a_t for the squared distance and w_t for 1/(2 eta_t). Expand each difference a_t w_t-a_(t+1)w_t. The initial a_1w_1 occurs once positively and the terminal a_(T+1)w_T once negatively. Each interior a_(t+1) occurs with coefficient w_(t+1)-w_t. Collect these coefficients and substitute reciprocal steps, retaining the factor1/2. The printed full equality includes the same gradient-energy sum sum eta_t||g_t||^2/2 on each side; add that common sum back to this extracted identity to recover the full display, or cancel it to isolate this identity. T=1 has no interior sum.
Lean reading notes
Source Euclidean squared distances specialize an explicitly more general NormedAddCommGroup identity. The underlying real-sequence lemma allows signed/zero potentials and weights, no monotonicity and no terminal bound. The distance theorem retains T>0 and eta_t>0 at every played index. Lean index0 is source round1, x(T) is source x_(T+1), eta(T-1) is source eta_T. No loss regularity, feedback legality, feasible-set diameter or algorithm recursion is asserted by this algebraic equality. No missing-half source correction is proposed. The distance proof actually reuses BanditRL.OnlineWeightedPotential.weighted_difference_sum_eq. The scalar companion VALUE contains Finset.sum_range_by_parts and Finset.sum_range_sub'. These are selected actual compiled VALUE occurrences, not necessity claims or a complete transitive graph. Exact folded statements and full proof source links expose both declarations through the shared catalog. Existing OGD/OSD production theorems remain prospective reuse overlays only; their accepted bodies are unchanged.

code.text: theorem weighted_difference_sum_eq (a w : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) : (∑ t ∈ range T, (a t - a (t + 1)) * w t) = a 0 * w 0 - a T * w (T - 1) + ∑ t ∈ range (T - 1), (w (t + 1) - w t) * a (t + 1)

theorem distance_potential_sum_eq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (x : ℕ → E) (u : E) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hη : ∀ t < T, 0 < η t) : (∑ t ∈ range T, (‖x t - u‖ ^ 2 - ‖x (t + 1) - u‖ ^ 2) / (2 * η t)) = ‖x 0 - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η 0) - ‖x T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η (T - 1)) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ t ∈ range (T - 1), (1 / η (t + 1) - 1 / η t) * ‖x (t + 1) - u‖ ^ 2
